title: Pin runtime chart versions + add bootstrap hooks for provision-to-ready pipeline
author: Sahana Iyer
description:
Context: This is part of the provision-to-ready automation sprint. We need a deterministic, reproducible cluster bootstrap step for Dedicated pools and a way for the orchestration service to safely re-run bootstrap without accidentally pulling newer runtime bits. This PR does two things: (1) pins runtime chart dependency versions and image tags so a given provisioning run is fully reproducible, and (2) adds optional Helm hook-based bootstrap jobs that can be invoked by the provisioning pipeline to run cluster registration + readiness bootstrap steps before the control plane transitions to Validating/Ready.

What changed: 1) Version pinning: - Pin chart dependencies for runtime components (runtime, agent, metrics sidecars) via Chart.yaml + Chart.lock. - Default values now require explicit runtime image tags (no :latest / floating tags) and include a single top-level runtimeVersion that templates into all images by default. - Add a CI guard script that fails if an unpinned image tag is introduced.

2) Bootstrap hooks (opt-in): - Add templates for a bootstrap Job that runs as a Helm hook (pre-install, pre-upgrade) when bootstrap.enabled=true. - The job calls a small internal bootstrap command (fleet-bootstrap) with parameters needed by the provisioner (pool_id, region, sku, run_id). - Hook emits structured logs suitable for the provisioning event pipeline (stage=bootstrapping, action=start/finish/fail, correlation_id). - Hook has conservative defaults: activeDeadlineSeconds=1200, backoffLimit=0, and delete policy to avoid orphaned jobs. - Provide a separate post-install smoke Job (optional) to validate DNS/TLS wiring for the cluster control-plane endpoints when bootstrap.smokeTest.enabled=true.

Rollout/compatibility: - Hooks are disabled by default to avoid impacting existing pool expansions and manual Helm upgrades. - When enabled, the hook requires a secret (bootstrap.serviceTokenSecret) that the provisioner will create/attach in the target namespace. - Charts remain compatible with existing values files; if runtimeVersion is not provided, behavior is unchanged except we now warn (NOT fail) and print the resolved image tags.

Rollback steps (operator/provisioner): - To disable hooks for an impacted pool, set bootstrap.enabled=false and re-run helm upgrade. - If a hook Job is stuck, delete the job and rerun only the bootstrap stage from the provisioner (preferred) or re-run helm upgrade with --set bootstrap.forceRunId=<new-id>. - If a chart upgrade introduces an issue, use helm rollback <release> <revision> (the dependency pinning ensures rollback returns to the exact prior runtime bits). - For emergency unblocking, set bootstrap.breakGlassSkip=true (adds an annotation + log line for auditing; the provisioner should still keep the pool out of routing until validation passes).

Notes for provisioner integration: - Hook jobs accept env vars: POOL_ID, REGION, SKU, PROVISION_RUN_ID and CONTROL_PLANE_URL. - The job writes a short JSON summary to stdout (pass/fail + durations) that can be scraped from logs. Example line: {"stage":"bootstrapping","pool_id":"pool_9f3a","run_id":"prv_01H...","result":"pass","duration_s":418}.

Test plan: - helm template + unit tests for templating correctness (charts/test). - k3d smoke test in CI to confirm hook jobs run and are cleaned up. - Manual validation in staging with a fake token secret and a dummy pool_id (documented in charts/redwood-dedicated/README.md).

Follow-ups (out of scope): - Wire perf-canary readiness suite as a post-install hook (tracked in ENG-2747). - Enforce runtimeVersion at provisioning time (currently warning-only) once existing pools have been migrated.
commits: charts(redwood-dedicated): pin runtime dependency versions and commit Chart.lock
charts: introduce runtimeVersion and template image tags consistently
charts: add bootstrap hook Job templates (pre-install/pre-upgrade)
charts: add optional post-install smoke test Job (dns/tls)
ci: fail on floating image tags in values/templates
docs: add rollback + hook enablement notes to README
conversation:
Vanessa Ortiz (review): Can we guarantee the hook won’t fire on every upgrade from routine SRE changes? We want the provisioner to control bootstrap execution, not normal chart bumps.

Sahana Iyer (author): Hook is gated by bootstrap.enabled (default false). For provisioning runs, the provisioner will enable it explicitly and pass PROVISION_RUN_ID. For normal upgrades, bootstrap.enabled remains false.

Rafael Mendes (review): Hook delete policy is important. If the job fails, we still want the logs, but also don’t want orphaned jobs to accumulate. What’s the behavior?

Sahana Iyer (author): Updated to use "helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded. For failures, the job remains (and logs remain) until the next hook run or manual cleanup. Also set ttlSecondsAfterFinished only when succeeded (so failure artifacts are retained).

Nina Petrova (review): Please ensure Chart.lock is committed and that dependency versions are pinned for runtime/agent charts as well. Also, clarify how runtimeVersion interacts with explicit per-image tags.

Sahana Iyer (author): Done. Chart.lock is included. Added precedence doc in README: explicit image.tag overrides runtimeVersion; otherwise tag defaults to runtimeVersion.

Ethan Park (review): The bootstrap job needs to be able to post to control plane with a short timeout and clear error. Can we surface control plane URL + run_id in the failure message?

Sahana Iyer (author): Added those fields to the job args and the log prefix. NOTES.txt now prints the last bootstrap job name and a kubectl logs command including the run id.

Connor O'Brien (review): Add explicit rollback steps in the README and mention that helm rollback is safe because the runtime bits are pinned.

Sahana Iyer (author): Added a "Rollback" section with helm rollback commands + disabling hooks instructions.

Rafael Mendes (follow-up): Active deadline 20m feels high. Any reason not to keep it tighter?

Sahana Iyer (author): Reduced to 15m (900s) and added a values override (bootstrap.activeDeadlineSeconds). Also set backoffLimit=0 to avoid retries hiding persistent failures.

CI: Initial run failed on charts-ci / lint due to an unused helper template. Fixed in commit "charts: remove unused helper" and reran CI.

Final review: All reviewers approved after the hook delete-policy and deadline tweaks. Merged via squash.
release_notes: Dedicated chart supports optional provisioning bootstrap hook Jobs (disabled by default).
Runtime chart dependencies and image tags can be pinned via runtimeVersion to make provisioning runs reproducible.
Added documentation for safe rollback and hook disablement.
